headline.title: A Humanoid Company Backed by Eric Trump Is Preparing Its Robots for War
headline.summary: Foundation Future Industries, backed by Eric Trump, is developing humanoid robots with potential military applications, as stated by the company's CEO. The firm is reportedly exploring "kinetic things" in its robotics initiatives.

articles.title: HP fined 1.4 billion rupees for “cartelization” of ink cartridges, toner, PCs
articles.summary: HP has been fined 1.4 billion rupees for engaging in "cartelization" related to the sale of ink cartridges, toner, and PCs. The penalty follows allegations that resellers were pressured to abandon HP's printing supplies in favor of counterfeit products.

articles.title: Create, edit and star in videos with two Google Vids updates
articles.summary: Google has introduced two updates to Google Vids: Gemini Omni, which enhances video creation and editing capabilities, and Personal Avatars, allowing users to star in their own videos. These features aim to improve user engagement and personalization in video content.

articles.title: EZSMT Version 3, Matured
articles.summary: The article introduces EZSMTV3, an advanced framework for Constraint Answer Set Programming (CASP) that integrates Answer Set Programming with Constraint Processing and Satisfiability Modulo Theories. This new version enhances the translational approach to solving complex combinatorial search problems through its extensible design and implementation.

articles.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
articles.summary: The article investigates whether gains from agent optimization methods compound over time in a continual learning context, using the Terminal-Bench 2.0 framework. It highlights that most previous evaluations have focused on one-time optimizations, which may not reflect the performance of agents in real-world scenarios where they face new challenges continuously.

articles.title: LessonBench-V1: A Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating AI Lesson Generation Agents
articles.summary: The article introduces LessonBench-V1, a new benchmark dataset designed to evaluate AI lesson generation agents, consisting of 647 human-written lessons and LLM-generated lesson plans across 240 STEM topics. This dataset aims to provide a standardized method for assessing the effectiveness of AI educational content generation systems.

articles.title: Full-Pipeline Inference Optimization for MiMo-V2.5 Series: Pushing Hybrid SWA Efficiency to the Limit
articles.summary: The article discusses a full-pipeline inference optimization for the MiMo-V2.5 model series, integrating Hybrid Sliding Window Attention, sparse Mixture-of-Experts, and multimodal encoders. The optimization aims to enhance efficiency in production by improving the KVCache system, thereby reducing compute and storage requirements.

articles.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
articles.summary: Boogu-Image-0.1 is a new open-source model family designed for unified multimodal understanding and generation, featuring variants such as Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo. It excels in text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual text rendering in Chinese and English.

articles.title: RAGthoven at SemEval-2026 Task 1: A Multi-Stage Pipeline Walks Into a Benchmark and Barely Clears the Bar
articles.summary: The article introduces RAGthoven, a system developed for the SemEval-2026 Task 1 focused on multilingual constrained humor generation in English, Spanish, and Chinese. RAGthoven employs a multi-stage pipeline of large language models, incorporating humor theories to enhance the creative text generation process.

articles.title: Audited Selective Verification for Risk-Controlled N-1 Thermal Contingency Screening under Deployment Shift
articles.summary: The paper presents Audited Selective Verification, a method for risk-controlled N-1 thermal contingency screening in energy management systems. This approach balances the need for assurance against cost by providing a statistical guarantee while avoiding the pitfalls of traditional verification methods that may overlook unsafe operating conditions.

articles.title: GeoAnchor: Collaborative Reasoning via Latent Decomposition for 3D Spatial Understanding
articles.summary: The article presents GeoAnchor, a novel approach for enhancing 3D spatial understanding by utilizing collaborative reasoning through latent decomposition. This method addresses the limitations of existing multimodal large language models in accurately interpreting 3D spatial relationships from 2D images by employing multiple latent representations to better capture continuous geometric information.

articles.title: UTS at ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff: structural shifts in AI writing bypass state-of-the-art detectors
articles.summary: A recent study presented at ELOQUENT 2026 reveals that certain language model evasion attacks can successfully bypass state-of-the-art AI writing detectors, even after adversarial fine-tuning. The research highlights a critical vulnerability in detection systems, indicating that shifting generated text outside the detector's training distribution can effectively evade detection.
